native_frames: METTL7A canonical AlphaFold DB v6 frame
METTL7B canonical AlphaFold DB v6 frame
coordinate_policy.sam_policy: Use the Stage 0 validated SAM coordinates unchanged in every construct of the corresponding target.
coordinate_policy.atom_ordering: Preserve parent receptor atom order; replace mutated side-chain records in canonical residue position; append fixed SAM identically within each target.

productive_tsl.conformer_generation: RDKit ETKDGv3 followed by ligand-only MMFF optimization
productive_tsl.family_clustering: complete linkage, direct same-atom-order heavy-atom RMSD <= 2.0 A

limited_response_phase.movable_residues: Side chains with any heavy atom within 4.5 A of the candidate TSL; local backbone atoms only for residues that remain a direct <2.0 A obstruction after side-chain response.

productive_tsl.retention: Retain every passing geometry family medoid; do not choose a score-best state.

dcmb_docking.canonical_site_assignment: At least 70% of DCMB heavy atoms within 4.0 A of a sphere in the target's 197-sphere homologous SAM superpocket.
dcmb_docking.off_site_handling: Retain raw pose; classify REJECTED_OUTSIDE_CANONICAL_SITE; exclude from pose families.
dcmb_docking.family_clustering: Per system and enantiomer, complete linkage direct same-atom-order heavy-atom RMSD <= 2.0 A.
dcmb_docking.representative: Family medoid by minimum mean direct RMSD; ties by seed then mode. Engine score is not used.
dcmb_docking.score_policy: Store as docking-engine output only; never interpret as potency, affinity, probability, or evidence priority.

sam_compatibility.close_nonoverlapping: none <2.0 A and any pair <2.5 A

dcmb_docking.batch_failure: If any seed returns fewer than 8 modes or any receptor loses fixed SAM, mark that system/enantiomer NOT_EVALUABLE_DOCKING_FAILURE; do not synthesize poses or selectively rerun with changed settings.

independent_outputs: receptor movement required for productive TSL
ligand centroid and orientation in canonical site frame

metric_definitions.contact_fingerprint: Residue has any protein-ligand heavy-atom distance <=4.5 A; report residue and minimum distance.
metric_definitions.local_accessible_volume: 0.5 A grid within 3.0 A of the ligand or predefined site probe and at least 2.0 A from protein heavy atoms.
metric_definitions.direct_overlap: Report minimum DCMB-TSL distance, pair counts <2.0 and <2.5 A, shared 1.0 A core-envelope volume, shared 1.7 A occupied volume, and atoms within the reciprocal 1.7 A envelopes.
metric_definitions.transfer_corridor: Finite segment from TSL sulfur to SAM methyl carbon; report ligand distances and occupied fractions at radii 1.5, 2.0, and 2.5 A. Blockade requires a DCMB atom projected within the segment and <=2.0 A from it.
metric_definitions.movement_interference: Report minimum DCMB-to-moving-atom path distance, paths <3.4 A and <2.0 A, and shared 1.7 A swept-envelope volume. Mechanistic gating requires swept overlap >=0.5 A3.
metric_definitions.centroid_orientation: Ligand heavy-atom centroid and principal long axis in the native receptor frame and the common METTL7A frame; orientation sign canonicalized toward the pocket mouth.
metric_definitions.bottleneck: Minimum opposing-wall heavy-atom surface separation along the preregistered 43/199-to-195/232 corridor; preserve every named residue-pair distance separately.
metric_definitions.mutation_change: Mutant minus same-target WT for each raw metric; never combine dimensions.

interference_classification.broadly_interfering: Direct <2.0 A overlap or transfer-corridor blockade in every retained productive TSL family.
interference_classification.state_dependent_interfering: The same condition occurs in at least one but not all retained productive TSL families.
interference_classification.non_interfering_escape: No direct <2.0 A overlap, no 2.0 A corridor blockade, and zero shared 1.7 A occupied volume for at least one retained productive state.
interference_classification.not_evaluable: No retained productive TSL state or no accepted DCMB family exists for the system.

mutation_matrix.additivity_rule: For seed-sampled metrics, additive if the stratified-by-enantiomer seed bootstrap 95% interval for I includes zero; cooperative if it excludes zero in the same direction as the double-WT effect; antagonistic if it excludes zero in the opposite direction. For deterministic single-structure metrics without replicates, report I but categorical additivity is NOT_EVALUABLE.
mutation_matrix.asymmetry_rule: Reciprocal effects are asymmetric when their direction or evaluability differs, or when normalized seed-bootstrap intervals do not overlap after expressing each change relative to its own WT. Do not require reciprocal symmetry.

global_stop_rules: Any coordinate-frame mismatch above the fixed gate
WT control produces no accepted DCMB family
Arbitrary response exceeds the limited-response gates
A requested observation is unavailable: emit NOT_EVALUABLE rather than zero
No new metric, residue scan, docking campaign, MD, or composite score may be introduced in response to an unexpected result
verdict_policy: No master verdict or composite score. Each evidence dimension and failure reason is reported independently. Scientific conclusions must retain EXPERIMENTAL, STRUCTURAL_OBSERVATION, COMPUTATIONAL_HYPOTHESIS, or PREDICTION labels.
